effect_unit: percentage points (pp); raw AP multiplied by 100

findings.claim: Raw synthetic utility is unstable across the observed generation realizations.
findings.limits: 三次 generation-RNG realization 不是三个 detector seed；不能估计总体方差或由 mAP 反推具体像素机制。

findings.claim: Raw SD2 does not show stable positive headroom on V2.
findings.limits: 针对该冻结 V2 split、generator checkpoints、slots 和 detector protocol；不是所有 SD2 配置或 synthetic 数据的无效证明。

findings.claim: One individual generation realization outperformed RealRepeat.
findings.limits: 保留正结果，但不选 C 作为获胜模型、不增加 bank、不据此声称稳定 baseline 有效。

findings.claim: The tested late exposure schedule reduced across-bank sample spread but also reduced mean utility.
findings.limits: 这是 detector internal_dev conditional on frozen generator。生成器历史用过 33 个 dev-group annotation inputs，不是独立 pipeline holdout 或 official final_eval。相同 scheduled attempts，successful updates 为 442–443，不能称严格实际更新相等。样本 SD 下降不等于总体方差降低已证实。

findings.claim: Generation RNG changes measured detector loss and selected-gradient signals; exported feature differences are descriptive bank-level evidence only.

observations.feature_summary_level: class x bank x backbone/neck ROI

findings.limits: 非零 range 不是显著性测试；不证明 variation 造成 utility。没有 matched per-slot feature triplet 或原始 vectors，不能把 feature 也写成同等强度的配对证据。

findings.claim: No negative-gradient-conflict mechanism was identified at the measured frozen initialization.
findings.limits: YOLO11s public initialization 的四个代表参数张量；不覆盖所有参数或训练轨迹，不能声称训练过程中没有冲突。

findings.claim: No unique loss, gradient-norm, gradient-direction or feature mechanism currently explains utility under the predeclared requirements.
findings.limits: Real target multiplicity 与 synthetic single-target 不同；total loss 中 classification 占主导。Feature effective-rank 的实/合样本数上界不同。没有机制干预或预测验证。
